# xxHash (vendored)

`xxhash.h` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from xxHash v0.8.3
(https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash, tag `v0.8.3`). Only `xxhash.h` is used. The library is
BSD-2-Clause, Copyright Yann Collet; `LICENSE` is xxHash's own licence file for it.

`xxhash.h.license` is a REUSE sidecar added by this project: the header carries a copyright line and
the BSD text but no `SPDX-License-Identifier`, and the header must stay byte-exact, so the
identifier lives beside it.

Do not edit these files. To update xxHash, replace them with a newer release and record the new
version and checksums in the plan of the gate that does it.
